statement: A snapshot lane still in flight at the certification deadline is classified as an unreadable oracle, not as an inactive cluster: the blindness resolver (test/distributed/harness/oracle-blindness.js) decides on the typed deadline-bounded laneOutcome marker its producer emits and carries the typed lane reason as the transport error, instead of inferring sight from the empty probe-witness list such a record necessarily has. On GCP run 2026-08-30T17-32-03 every one of the five nodes reported active and the seed answered control_snapshot at t+62.9 s against a 61 s verdict, yet the harness printed 'Not all nodes reached ACTIVE state within 60000ms' — a label that sent five consecutive forensics hunting a cluster stall that never existed. An empty probe-witness list from any other producer keeps its prior not-blind meaning, the gate verdict is unchanged (a deadline-bounded lane still fails the check because coverage is incomplete), and the window, poll interval, extension rules, re-sample admission and progress classification are untouched. Proven deterministically on the real resolver: red on HEAD, green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Blindness for a deadline-bounded lane is decided by the typed laneOutcome marker its producer emits, never by inferring sight or blindness from an empty probe-witness list; an empty list from any other producer keeps its prior not-blind meaning.

The gate verdict itself is unchanged: a deadline-bounded lane still FAILS the ACTIVE check (coverage is incomplete); only its classification and reported reason change, so an unreadable oracle is never reported as an inactive cluster.
The 60-second certification window, the poll interval, the extension rules, the re-sample admission and the progress classification are unchanged; no src/ change.

Proof is a deterministic witness on the real blindness resolver reproducing GCP run 2026-08-30T17-32-03 (all five nodes active, coverage 0/5, lane in flight at the deadline), red on HEAD and green after, with the surrounding blindness scenarios and the attempt-join contract as controls that must stay green.
